query:
SELECT concat_ws(
            '|',
            table_name,
            ordinal_position::text,
            column_name,
            data_type,
            udt_name,
            is_nullable,
            COALESCE(column_default, '')
        )
        FROM information_schema.columns
        WHERE table_schema = 'public'
            AND table_name = ANY($1)
        ORDER BY table_name, ordinal_position
